goal: Trace the developmental trajectory from contrastive vision-language pretraining (CLIP) to instruction-following multimodal large language models.

definitions.CLIP: Dual-encoder trained to align images and captions contrastively.
definitions.visual instruction tuning: Fine-tuning a multimodal model on image-grounded instructions.
definitions.Q-Former: Lightweight querying transformer bridging a frozen vision encoder and a frozen LLM.
